description: ICF folding: golf.pdb lists several procedures at one RVA (0x2180: eight, from Plot.obj, SoundDevice.obj and window.obj of jackal.lib; 0x2190: fifteen). Which source function the original linker kept at such an address is not determined by the PDB. smsg_import.py keeps ONE MATCH line per address (the first candidate symbol that compiles 100% to the original bytes, e.g. ?fill_entry@?$ClassList@USpriteStruct@@@@UAEHPAUSpriteStruct@@@Z for `xor eax, eax; ret 4` at 0x00402180) and marks the other procedures at that address `folded`. The match proves the bytes, not which name the original source gave them.
path to resolution: names step (S10.8): pick a name from the callers / vtable slots, not from the folded list
